name: alcatraz
title: 3 men vanished from this prison
caption: June 1962. Frank Morris and John and Clarence Anglin left dummy heads in their beds and vanished from Alcatraz on a raincoat raft. They were never found. Comment 'THEY MADE IT' or 'THEY DROWNED' #alcatraz #escapefromalcatraz #sanfrancisco #unsolved #truecrime #hauntedplaces #creepypartner

slides.text: San Francisco Bay. Alcatraz, 'The Rock'. A federal prison from 1934 to 1963.
Freezing water, strong currents, and more than a mile to shore. It was built so no one could leave.
1962. Frank Morris and brothers John and Clarence Anglin spent months digging through the vents behind their sinks.
They made dummy heads for their beds. Plaster, paint... and real human hair.
Night of June 11. They climbed to the roof, slipped down to the shore and pushed off on a raft made of raincoats.
At the morning count, the guards found the dummies. The men were gone.
36 men tried 14 escapes. Most were caught, shot or drowned. Morris and the Anglins were never found.
The U.S. Marshals still list them as wanted. Today it's a national park... and night tours walk these halls.
